semantic_identity_corrections.er1_scope: Engineering Resource & Latency Evaluation (Not an academic research question RQ4/H4)

hardware_environment.device_name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU
hardware_environment.empirical_sweet_spot_reference: 20.43 hours per 12-epoch full Stage-A2-class run (~94.7 min/train epoch, ~7.5 min/val epoch)

model_level_replications.interpretation: Primary inferential unit is across model-level replications.

data_level_bootstrap.role: Nested within-run data sampling uncertainty quantification. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from substituting for training seed replication (No Pseudoreplication).

primary_h2_campaign.research_question: Does joint multi-view alignment (Sequence + Temporal Graph with VICReg) achieve non-inferior or superior detection performance relative to matched single-view baselines under identical prospective conditions without representation collapse?

configurations.description: Transformer Sequential Encoder trained exclusively on event sequences and dynamic parameters under prospective harness
Temporal Graph Neural Network trained exclusively on causal graph relations and dynamic node memory under prospective harness
Joint Multi-View Architecture connecting Sequence View, Temporal Graph View, VICReg Alignment, and Gated Dynamic Fusion

primary_h2_campaign.historical_baselines_role: EXPLORATORY_REFERENCE_ONLY (All 9 confirmed runs use the new prospective harness)

fair_comparability_contract.data_exposure_per_epoch: 35,000 Train Sessions (586,577 events), 7,500 Val Sessions (119,531 events)
fair_comparability_contract.stopping_policy: Early stopping patience=3 epochs on validation loss or 12-epoch ceiling
fair_comparability_contract.downstream_probe_capacity: Linear / Logistic Probe W in R^{128 x 2} (zero hidden layers, capacity d x C)
fair_comparability_contract.optimizer_notes_pre_training: Sequence-only operates on sequence batches; Graph-only operates on event windows with 4-window accumulation; Multi-view operates on paired session streams. Steps per epoch may differ naturally by data granularity, but epoch ceiling and total event exposures are strictly matched.

comparisons: Multi-View Aligned vs Sequence-Only (delta_vs_seq = AP_mv - AP_seq)
Multi-View Aligned vs Graph-Only (delta_vs_graph = AP_mv - AP_graph)

verdict_criteria.SUPPORTED: Multi-View satisfies non-inferiority against both single-views (delta_vs_seq >= -0.02 and delta_vs_graph >= -0.02) AND achieves statistically significant superiority (delta > 0, 95% CI excludes 0) over at least one single-view baseline, with Var(z_mv) >= 0.01.
verdict_criteria.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: Multi-View satisfies non-inferiority against both single-views (delta >= -0.02) without variance collapse, demonstrating robust multi-modal integration without negative transfer, but does not achieve strictly superior AP over both.
verdict_criteria.FALSIFIED: Multi-View is significantly inferior to either Sequence-only or Graph-only (delta < -0.02 with 95% CI excluding -0.02) OR suffers representation collapse (Var(z_mv) < 0.01).
verdict_criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Confidence intervals span across -0.02 without definitive directional resolution across seeds.

unaligned_fusion_ablation.execution_policy: DO_NOT_EXECUTE_BY_DEFAULT; evaluated only if remaining 15-day compute permits after 9 confirmed runs complete.
unaligned_fusion_ablation.causal_claim_condition: No causal claim regarding VICReg anti-collapse benefit can be asserted unless the matched aligned-vs-unaligned ablation is empirically executed.

primary_h2_campaign.pcgrad_status: DECLARED_ONLY_ABSENT_IN_CODE (No PCGrad implementation for this campaign; zero empirical PCGrad benefit claimed).

h1_parameter_fidelity_campaign.primary_direct_target: param_targets (Categorical dynamic parameter classes: IP categories, byte size buckets)
h1_parameter_fidelity_campaign.primary_direct_metric: Macro-F1 on Parameter Category Recovery Probe (accounting for class imbalance)
h1_parameter_fidelity_campaign.secondary_utility_metric: Downstream Anomaly Average Precision (AP) on HDFS_ANOMALY_LABEL
h1_parameter_fidelity_campaign.masking_ablation_definition: Evaluating the frozen parameter-aware encoder with param_slots=None versus active param_slots.
h1_parameter_fidelity_campaign.circularity_qualifier: Because param_targets were utilized in the SSL pretraining objective (L_MPP), parameter category recovery measures whether the representation retains linearly accessible parameter semantics; it does not constitute independent proof of downstream anomaly detection superiority. Downstream Anomaly AP serves as secondary relevance evidence.
h1_parameter_fidelity_campaign.allowed_inference: Dynamic parameter slots contribute linearly decodable security information retained in the frozen representation.
h1_parameter_fidelity_campaign.forbidden_inference: Does not prove that a parameter-aware pretraining regime is superior to an independently trained template-only regime.

confirmatory_operators.warrant: Drops non-structural filler words while preserving block identifiers and critical verbs; semantic session goal is invariant.
confirmatory_operators.construct_tested: Resilience to minor logging format omissions
confirmatory_operators.allowed_inference: Representation does not rely on superficial filler tokens.

confirmatory_operators.warrant: Injects benign background daemon heartbeats without altering anomalous session structures.
confirmatory_operators.allowed_inference: Model filters out unrelated asynchronous system heartbeats.

confirmatory_operators.warrant: Injective hex-to-decimal parameter conversion. Numerical values and relational dependencies are strictly invariant.
confirmatory_operators.allowed_inference: Representation is invariant to base-10 vs base-16 numerical formatting.

confirmatory_operators.warrant: Concurrency-safe reordering strictly limited to events sharing the exact same physical timestamp; causal order is preserved.
confirmatory_operators.allowed_inference: Model is immune to arbitrary concurrency serialization order.

confirmatory_operators.warrant: Bijective 1-to-1 IP translation (|unique(in)| == |unique(out)|). Communication topology and graph isomorphism are preserved.
confirmatory_operators.allowed_inference: Model learns topological communication structure rather than memorizing static IP strings.

confirmatory_operators.warrant: Syntactic relative path aliasing (inserting redundant ./). Points to identical file system objects.
confirmatory_operators.allowed_inference: Model is invariant to redundant relative directory syntax.

confirmatory_operators.warrant: Bijective host name remapping preserving host-node bijection and graph topology.
confirmatory_operators.allowed_inference: Model learns structural host roles rather than static hostnames.

exploratory_operators.warrant: Injects rapid bursts altering inter-arrival times; tests temporal encoder under traffic spikes rather than semantic invariance.
Replaces verbs with synonyms, testing Drain parser OOD vocabulary behavior rather than within-schema invariance.
Rotates pseudonym salts across boundaries, testing cross-window memory decay.
Adds bounded temporal jitter (+/- 2s), testing sensitivity to clock drift.
Compound multi-operator stress test combining multiple degradations.

h3_robustness_perturbation_campaign.decision_rule: Confirmatory robustness conclusion is computed exclusively over the 7 SEMANTIC_PRESERVING_WITH_WARRANT operators using Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q < 0.05). Exploratory operators are reported separately as distribution stress tests without pooling.

er1_operational_feasibility.evaluation_order: Executes after H2 confirmatory training via protocols/h4_operational_benchmark.py (0 training steps).

deferred_families.h4_attention_mil: DEFERRED to later phase (requires fine-grained ground truth annotations not available in HDFS).
deferred_families.h5_privacy_frontier: DEFERRED to later phase to preserve core 15-day budget for H2/H1/H3.

pilot_strategy.purpose: Hardware memory verification (VRAM < 4 GB), NaN/Inf gradient check, metric schema validation, runtime calibration
pilot_strategy.exclusion_rule: Pilot metrics are strictly quarantined as PILOT_DEBUG_ONLY and excluded from confirmatory statistical aggregation.
